note: Versions are pinned here so a build never silently upgrades. scripts/test-native-android.py --suite foundation fails when this file, gradle/libs.versions.toml, the Gradle wrapper, native/core/go.mod or .github/workflows/android.yml disagree. 'verified' says how each fact was established.

go.verified: the version ci.yml/windows.yml already use and the dev machine runs (go1.26.6 darwin/arm64)

x_mobile.pinned_by: native/core/go.mod tool block (gomobile, gobind); scripts/build-native-android.py builds both from it into .runtime/android/bin
x_mobile.decision: Not the newest x/mobile (2026-10-11): that one requires golang.org/x/crypto 0.58, x/net 0.61, x/sys 0.49 and go 1.26.0, and minimal version selection would have moved every desktop Core build (macOS, Windows) onto those versions. This commit is the newest whose requirements equal what the Core already links (x/sys 0.30, x/net 0.35, x/sync 0.11, via x/tools 0.30); it only adds build-time tool modules. go version -m on the darwin asterlink-core shows x/crypto 0.33, x/net 0.35, x/sys 0.30 before and after. It includes 'bind: pin go/types to not produce types.Alias types' (2025-02-18). Upgrade together with a deliberate golang.org/x refresh that all three clients re-test.
x_mobile.verified: 2026-10-15: gomobile bind of native/core/mobile for android/arm64 with NDK 28.2 and Go 1.26.6 succeeds without extra flags (no -checklinkname=0 needed for the pinned Mihomo)

ndk.page_alignment: r28 links shared objects with 16 KB max-page-size by default; scripts/build-native-android.py requires every LOAD segment of libgojni.so to be aligned to >= 0x4000
ndk.verified: installed on the dev machine; first local bind: 4 LOAD segments, all 0x4000

libraries_round3.verified: newest stable releases in Google's Maven / Maven Central metadata on 2026-10-15; pinned in gradle/libs.versions.toml
libraries_round3.decision: Screenshot tests run on Robolectric's Android 15 sandbox (sdk 35): its Android 16 sandbox requires Java 21 and this lock pins JDK 17. Compose rendering does not depend on the sandbox; the app keeps targetSdk 36 and is verified on the API 36 emulator. Navigation Compose and material-icons-extended are not used (four destinations without deep links; only the icons the app shows are packaged as vectors).

release_round6.key: self-signed PKCS12, alias asterlink, RSA 4096, 30 years, outside the repository (~/.asterlink/android), password in the macOS login Keychain; created by scripts/package-native-android.py --create-keystore
release_round6.r8: proguard-android-optimize.txt + app/proguard-rules.pro (gomobile go.** and com.asterlink.core.** kept by name for JNI); resources shrunk
